item.title: Key Takeaways from the National Conference on Strengthening Panchayat Audit Systems
item.description:
Key Takeaways from the National Conference on Strengthening Panchayat Audit Systems

The Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), in collaboration with the Comptroller and Auditor General (C&AG), conducted a national-level deliberation to improve the audit ecosystem of Rural Local Bodies (RLBs). The discussions focused on improving accountability, transparency, digital audit systems, Action Taken Reports (ATRs), and strengthening the institutional capacity of Local Fund Audit Departments.

This article summarizes the major deliberations, recommendations, and action points that emerged from the conference.

item.title: Training on Auditing Serious Irregularities (TGS): Key Lessons from the AG Office
item.description:
Training on Auditing Serious Irregularities (TGS): Key Lessons from the AG Office

On 26 June 2025, officials from the Accountant General (AG) Office conducted a training-cum-discussion on Serious Irregularities (TGS). The session focused on strengthening the ability of auditors to identify, investigate, document, and report irregularities that have significant financial, legal, or governance implications.

The discussion emphasized that auditors should move beyond routine compliance checking and adopt a risk-based approach to detect irregularities that may involve fraud, corruption, deliberate misrepresentation, or systemic failures.
